name: 87505 · Santa Fe, NM
findings: ZIP 87505 (Santa Fe) has 310 nonprofit organizations. 153 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 118 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (11% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 87505 (Santa Fe) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 87505 (Santa Fe) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 72 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
